# Kavach Fitness

> Enterprise gym management SaaS platform for Indian fitness businesses. Manage memberships, payments, attendance, workout slips, PT bookings, trainers, staff, and multiple gym branches with role-based access control.

## Key facts

- Kavach Fitness is a multi-gym management platform (not a single-gym tool).
- It serves five roles: Super Admin (platform-wide), Gym Admin (gym owner/manager), Trainer, Staff, and Member.
- Members register to a specific gym branch and are approved by the gym admin.
- No default member/staff passwords are used; accounts are activated via one-time secure links.
- Payments support cash, UPI, card, bank transfer, and other manual methods, with PDF receipts.
